sloka: पादचारमिवादित्यं निष्पतन्तं सुदुर्दशम् ।ततस्ते प्रत्यभिज्ञाय अर्जुनाय निवेदयन् ।। ७.३३.५ ॥
transliteration: pādacāramivādityaṁ niṣpatantaṁ sudurdaśam ।tataste pratyabhijñāya arjunāya nivedayan ।। 7.33.5 ॥

translations.english: Then, seeing him appear like the sun walking on foot, very difficult to behold, they recognized him and reported his arrival to Arjuna.
